name: MaddenHQ
install: sudo service postgresql start || true; sudo -u postgres psql -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='maddenhq'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE USER maddenhq WITH PASSWORD 'maddenhq' SUPERUSER"; sudo -u postgres psql -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='maddenhq'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE maddenhq OWNER maddenhq"; cp -n .env.example .env || true; npm ci; npx prisma migrate deploy; npx prisma db seed || npm run db:seed
start: sudo service postgresql start || true; until pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -q; do sleep 1; done; exec npm run dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
